title.narrative: Migration and border management in Türkiye for 2024

description.narrative: This Action builds on previously EU-funded efforts and aims to achieve three major outcomes, each with corresponding outputs as outlined below:Outcome 1 focuses on increasing the effectiveness of the government of Türkiye in facilitating voluntary, safe and dignified returns to countries of origin, while ensuring continuous access to asylum and protection. This outcome includes three key Outputs. First, it will support the the Presidency for Migration Management in the Ministry of Interior (PMM) on the preparation for potential voluntary returns of Syrians under temporary protection to Syria, establishing voluntary return mechanisms and procedures in line with international law and increasing the sustainability of future voluntary returns. Additionally, it will assist PMM in strengthening international and temporary protection processes, including the provision of qualified staff at Provincial Directorates of Migration Management (PDMMs) to ensure continued access to registration and protection services. Finally, it will enhance the e voluntary returns of irregular migrants (non-Syrians) from Türkiye by, amongst others, supporting the National Assisted Voluntary Returns (N-AVR) mechanism and funding of safe and organised return operations respecting the vulnerabilities and rights of migrants.Outcome 2 on Border Management will include two additional Outputs. It will provide border control equipment, aligned with confirmed needs on the Eastern and South-eastern borders (with Iran and Iraq), to further ongoing EU-funded support. Additionally, it will enhance the technical capacities and coordination mechanisms at selected border crossing points. This outcome will also support the provision of r Search & Rescue (SAR) boats and personnel training, according to jointly agreed technical specifications and conditions of use.Outcome 3 emphasises enhancing the capacity of Turkish authorities. It will focus on three main (3) outputs. First, it will continue to support the operation and management of removal centres across the country, aiming to provide quality services, and improve reception conditions for irregular migrants. Additionally, it will provide capacity- building support to PMM for streamlining of residence permit processes along with equipment support in this area. Finally, it will offer capacity-building and equipment support to the Turkish Gendarmerie to strengthen efforts in the fight against migrant smuggling.
